pole.source: LOLA LDEM_75S_240M (PDS), polar stereographic, centre lat -90, lon 0
pole.projection: rho = 2R tan(c/2), c = colatitude from the south pole; X = rho sin(lon), Y = rho cos(lon), lon east-positive (matches core/lola_horizon.py)
pole.row_order: row 0 = +Y edge (north-ish, toward lon 0 meridian); col 0 = -X edge

globe.source: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit #4720 (LRO LROC WAC color, LOLA ldem_16)
globe.layout: equirectangular, left edge 180W, top row 90N, east-positive
globe.normal: tangent space, R=east G=north B=up, true (1x) slopes, faded to flat above |lat| 88
